annotations.title: Create or change a knowledge base store

description:
[Knowledge base] Without knowledge_base_store_id: a new store (name; strict true by default: the AI uses only its documents). With it: rename it or change strict, which changes how every interview on the store answers. upload_knowledge_base_document adds documents.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

knowledge_base_store_id.description: The store to change (from list_knowledge_base_stores). Left out: a new store is created.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional company to act on. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

name.description: Name of the store, 1 to 200 characters. Required for a new store; left out on a change, it stays.

strict.description: true (the default for a new store): the AI uses only these documents. Left out on a change, it stays.

name: save_knowledge_base_store
title: Create or change a knowledge base store
